backend_architecture.server:
- Creates Express app + HTTP server + Socket.IO server - Middleware order: cors(), express.json(50mb limit), express.urlencoded(50mb limit) - Mounts all route files under /api prefix - errorHandler middleware is LAST (catches all errors from routes) - Socket.IO handles: join-room, send-message, disconnect events - Health check: GET /api/health
Route mounting: /api/auth → src/routes/auth.js /api/projects → src/routes/projects.js /api/tasks → src/routes/tasks.js /api/dashboard → src/routes/dashboard.js /api/reports → src/routes/reports.js /api/users → src/routes/users.js /api/tickets → src/routes/ticket.js /api/organizations → src/routes/organizations.js /api/chat → src/routes/chat.js /api/timesheets → src/routes/timesheets.js /api/performance → src/routes/performance.js /api/worklogs → src/routes/worklog.js /api/superadmin → src/routes/superadmin.js /api/docs → Swagger UI

middleware.file:
authenticate(req, res, next): - Reads Bearer token from Authorization header - Verifies JWT using JWT_SECRET env var - Populates req.user with decoded payload: { id, email, role, organizationId } - organizationId is null for SUPERADMIN role. - Returns 401 if missing/invalid token
authorize(...roles)(req, res, next): - Checks req.user.role against allowed roles array - Returns 403 if role not allowed - Usage: router.post('/', authorize('ADMIN', 'MANAGER'), createProject)
Global error handler. Catches all errors thrown in route handlers. Returns JSON: { error: message } with appropriate status code. Works with express-async-errors (no try/catch needed in controllers).

requireFeature(featureKey): - Blocks API access if the requested feature is disabled for the user's organization. - Reuses the `getActiveFeatures()` logic (checking customFeatures over plan defaults). - Returns 403 { error: 'Feature not available' } if explicitly disabled. - SUPERADMIN role bypasses all feature gates automatically.

controllers.controller: Exports: login, signup, invite, me, changePassword, forgotPassword, resetPassword Uses: PrismaClient, bcryptjs (compare + hash), jsonwebtoken (sign), emailService JWT payload: { id, email, role, organizationId } JWT_SECRET from env. Token expiry: typically 7d.

Exports: getAllProjects, getProject, createProject, updateProject, deleteProject, addProjectMember, removeProjectMember Key logic in getAllProjects: - Role-based where clause (MANAGER sees own projects, CLIENT sees own client projects, MEMBER sees assigned projects) - ALL filters (search, status, category, managerId, clientId) applied via Prisma - Progress % calculated from storyPoints (preferred) or task count ratio - Pagination: if 'page' query param present → paginated; else → flat array Key validation in createProject: - name length 3-100, alphanumeric+spaces, no leading digit - Unique per org (case-insensitive) - category required, clientId required if category=CLIENT - Date logic validation

Exports: getAllTasks, getTask, createTask, updateTask, deleteTask, getMyTasks, updateTaskProgress, updateTaskStatus Key logic in getAllTasks: - Role-based where clause on project relation - All filters in Prisma where (projectId, status, priority, managerId, clientId, search) - Pagination: if 'page' present → paginated; else → flat array (for Kanban) Key validation in createTask: - title non-empty, alphanumeric+spaces, no leading digit - Unique per project (case-insensitive)

Exports: getUsers, updateUser, deleteUser, approveUser, getManagedUsers, updateProfile, getMemberProgress Key logic in getUsers: - Complex role-based visibility (Prisma OR conditions per role) - Returns users with derived 'managers' array (for frontend dependent filter) - Pagination or flat array based on 'page' param getMemberProgress: aggregates task stats (total, completed, in-progress, overdue)
Exports: getDashboardStats Returns: aggregate counts scoped to user org.
Exports: getMyOrganization, updateMyOrganization Note: Scoped to req.user.organizationId. Admin can update company info.

services.service: Exports various email sending functions: sendProjectManagerEmail(manager, project) sendProjectClientEmail(client, project) sendUserApprovalEmail(user) sendTaskAssignmentEmail(user, task, project) sendTaskStatusUpdateEmail(user, task) (and others for invites, password reset, etc.) Uses Nodemailer with SMTP config from env vars (SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS).

backend_architecture.socketio:
EVENTS SERVER LISTENS FOR: 'join-room' — payload: roomId(string). Socket joins that room. 'send-message' — payload: { content, userId, projectId }. Saves to DB (ChatMessage), broadcasts 'new-message' to room, broadcasts 'message-notification' to ALL connected users. 'disconnect' — logs disconnection.
EVENTS SERVER EMITS: 'new-message' — to specific room. payload: full message object with user. 'message-notification' — to ALL connected clients. payload: { roomId, senderId, content, senderName }. Frontend uses this to increment unread counts.
backend_architecture.environment_variables: DATABASE_URL — PostgreSQL connection string (required) JWT_SECRET — Secret for JWT signing (required) PORT — Server port (optional, default: 5000) SMTP_HOST — Email server host SMTP_PORT — Email server port SMTP_USER — Email username SMTP_PASS — Email password SMTP_FROM — From address for emails

recent_updates.update: Implemented manager approval workflow for timesheets. Global timer submissions (WorkLogs) are now synchronized with Timesheet approval processes. Notifications are dispatched upon status changes.

Enforced organization-level quotas (maxProjects, maxUsers) in controllers (`createProject`, `authController` invites). Returns 403 Forbidden with custom message prompting premium upgrade when limits are reached.
Normalized `activity_logs` in database (stripped newlines, UPPER() casing). Re-introduced `INVITED`, `APPROVED`, and `MEMBER_ADDED` to accurate front-end filtering.
